csv_project_name: Consultant for Capital Improvement Plan - Pocatello
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Pocatello invites interested parties to submit Proposals for the City of Pocatello s Capital Improvement Plan (CIP). In 2021 the City of Pocatello adopted its long-range plan, Comprehensive Plan 2040, to identify the City s priority goals as well as strategies to achieve those goals. The purpose of the CIP is to establish a capital program and plan that will identify: Capital projects and their alignment with priority needs and goals including the Comprehensive Plan; estimated cost of projects; estimated cost of maintenance of projects; timeframe for completion of projects; and the financial plan to adequately fund and resource those projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Consultant for Capital Improvement Plan - Pocatello
short_description: Consulting services for preparing Pocatello's capital improvement plan and funding strategy.
project_scope: Preparation of the City of Pocatello's Capital Improvement Plan based on Comprehensive Plan 2040, including identification of capital projects, alignment with priority needs and goals, estimated project costs, estimated maintenance costs, project completion timeframes, and a financial plan for funding and resourcing the projects.
services: Planning and master planning consultancy for a municipal capital improvement plan; urban studies, land use planning, and housing and urban development advisory services.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning/master planning consultancy without identifiable structural or engineering design scope.
- No bridge, building, roof, tower, stadium, or special structure project is defined.
- Falls under urban/open space planning and consulting-type services, which are not relevant for sbp.
- No technical planning component such as structural design or HOAI-equivalent service phases is indicated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The assignment is for preparation of a capital improvement plan rather than a defined construction project, so no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate can be derived from the tender notice.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As the notice is for general planning consultancy for a citywide capital improvement plan, no realistic sbp-specific engineering fee can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design. No specific reference counts or technical qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
